name: Ankle Alphabet

rehabilitation.clinical_protocol: AAOS Foot and Ankle Conditioning Program

steps: Sit comfortably on a chair with your leg lifted off the floor or resting on your opposite knee.
Imagine your big toe is a pen or pencil pointing forward.
Trace each capital letter of the alphabet in the air from A to Z using only your ankle and foot.
Make the letters as large as comfortable to move through all ranges of motion: dorsiflexion, plantarflexion, inversion, and eversion.
Complete the alphabet on one foot, then switch to the other side.
coaching_cues: Isolate the movement to the ankle joint; do not rotate your whole leg from the knee or hip.
Trace both small curves and wide angles deliberately.
Take your time with letters like S, W, and Z that require multiplanar coordination.

sources.attribution: AAOS Foot and Ankle Conditioning Program
